verdict.rationale: The only first-party event mechanism in the evidence is webhook notifications for support ticket events, which let users wire their own systems to react in near real-time. There is no evidence of user-defined rules that automatically act on Lambda resources (instances, clusters). Cloud-init runs only at launch, and the event-driven notifications in comm-3 come from an unofficial third-party tool. Missing for 10: a native rule/trigger engine, events covering instances, clusters or billing, configurable automatic actions (e.g. stop on idle), and independent corroboration.
